name: The Mad Monk: Reincarnation of the Dragon
Ascension
summary: Inspired by the novel Last Days by Adam Nevill, Ascension follows Rose, a relentless documentary filmmaker and recently divorced mother, brilliant at uncovering others' truths but struggling to resolve her own. When Rose begins a project on a mysterious 20th-century cult known as the Church of Ascension, she finds unexpected refuge in its teachings – until she discovers something far more insidious beneath.

name: Tut Elimi
summary: Their paths crossed as children. Years later, a tragic incident brings Aslan and Elvan together again, forcing them into a marriage of convenience built on sacrifice and duty. At the same time, the heroes must contend with the intrigues of their relatives and pressure from influential circles.

name: The Sticks
summary: After tragedy shatters a small Minnesota hockey town, a grieving wife steps behind the bench of the team her husband built, guiding a found family of wounded young athletes through a season of loss, love, and rivalry that will decide whether South Dorothy has anything left to believe in, and who will lead it into its next chapter.

The series takes place in the fall of 2018. Three Ukrainian warships depart from the Black Sea to Azov, performing a planned transition through the Kerch Strait. During the passage, Ukrainian crews are attacked, and 24 sailors are captured.

The next 286 days they will spend in Moscow Lefortovo. Despite the psychological pressure, interrogations and attempts to force Ukraine to renounce Ukraine, none of the sailors refused to take the military oath.

How and why did they survive? What role did the families of prisoners and their lawyers play in this struggle? And what really happened behind the walls of Lefortovo? The answers to these questions are in the events of the series 24.

name: Dalliance
summary: Dalliance follows retired cameraman Billy who unexpectedly crosses paths with chef Dani. An instant connection threatens to unravel decades of friendship and family. As one life-changing event sends shockwaves through an entire community, marriages are tested, new relationships ignite, old wounds resurface, and everyone is forced to confront the choices that have shaped their lives.

name: Hanyi Enters the Heart
summary: The Shen family is massacred, and young Shen Li witnesses Zhao Wujiu, Cui Hong, and a mysterious figure with a man-eating flower tattoo committing the murders. After narrowly escaping death with Xie Yungui's help, she takes the name Gu Hanyi and masters both medicine and strategy. Joining forces with other women, she carefully sets her revenge in motion. But after eliminating two of her enemies, she is shocked to discover that the third has been by her side all along...

name: Re:Petit - Re:Petit kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu
summary: Upon waking up, Subaru Natsuki finds himself in a parallel reality of the fantasy world he has come to accept as his own. Despite being familiar faces, Subaru's friends are vastly different, especially as they enjoy the life of modern society that he knows all too well. This mysterious world captures the intrepid boy's interest nonetheless, and a clash between his antics and the dubious inhabitants soon leads to all sorts of amusing scenarios.

previousepisode.name: Petit 14: That's All This Promotion Is About

name: Русские цари
summary:
The program is dedicated to the history of Russian rulers. Historical chronicles and literary works are used to reconstruct events from centuries ago.
Alexander Mikhailovich Panchenko is one of the leading scholars of our time, the author of classic works on the humorous culture of ancient Rus', on Russian culture on the eve of Peter the Great's reforms, and numerous articles on Old Russian literature.

name: Полный модерн!
summary: Comedy TV series from the creators of "Ostorozhno, Modern!" with Dmitriy Nagiyev and Sergey Rost in the lead roles.

name: Dearest
summary: The life of a top actress Wen Jianan collapses overnight. Witnessing her father He Mu commit a murder in the ancestral home, she flees in panic. However, she gets into a premeditated car crash and gets framed as the killer, leaving her disgraced, destitute, and under house arrest in a sanatorium by her own mother. Meanwhile, Jiang Yu, the mystery owner of Cloudsea Club, infiltrates her side as a rehabilitation therapist, with the aim to avenge his mother. During the hunt, he finds out that the real murderer is her father, and the two are actually half-siblings. After intense probing, manipulation, and suspicion, they recognize their common enemy and form a revenge alliance, setting traps to unravel shocking family scandals. When all sins are exposed and the truth comes to light, the two forge the sincerest bond and embrace a fresh start.

name: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
summary: In never-before-heard prison calls recorded before his death, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals the twisted motivations for his gruesome crimes.

name: Pif et Hercule se mettent au vert
summary: Spiff, Hercules and Pifi humorously expose harmful behaviors to the planet and encourage young people to change their consumption habits.

previousepisode.name: La préservation du bois mort et les chouettes

name: Tuzlu Kahve
summary: Salty Coffee begins with the intersection of the paths of Gözde, the daughter of one of Istanbul's established and wealthy families, and Mehmet, the heir to a holding company who has returned from America. The young couple, eager to marry, bring two families, seemingly incompatible, face to face.

name: Inside Selling Houses Australia: New Beginnings
summary: Revisits homeowners to see how they are faring after selling their unsellable homes with the help of property experts.

name: Крот Баюн
summary:
The son of a deceased police officer, the talented con artist Bayun, faces a choice: to make a deal with his father's friend, Colonel Rubin, or go to prison.

Bayun chooses the deal and becomes a "freelance consultant" in the Samara Department of Special Investigations (OSR), headed by Rubin.

Using his unconventional approach as a con artist, Bayun helps his new colleagues solve one case after another.

name: Why Are You Single?
summary: Comedian Marie Faustin, hosts as singles face outrageous challenges, reveal their biggest red flags, and fight for a shot at love!

name: Amadeo
summary: A mysteriously restless and indefatigable man who painted incessantly as if always sensing the brevity of the time he had left, Amadeo navigates an intense romance with Lucie and an explosive artistic career among the modernist avant-garde of Paris and Portugal before the ravages of World War I and the 1918 pandemic cut his life short at age thirty.

name: Ke Fou Xu Wo Zai Shao Nian
Três Irmãs
summary: In the coastal town of Caramirim, the three surfer sisters of the Jequitibá family fight for the region's environmental protection. But Violeta wants to build a hotel complex there.

name: The Detour with David Chang
summary: The Detour with David Chang follows the acclaimed chef, restaurateur and author in his pursuit of no-frills but unforgettable eats on the open road. In the age of influencers, algorithms and listicles, Chang cuts through the noise on a classic American road trip following local leads and friends' recommendations to his next meal. Each episode represents a different leg of Chang's journey, pairing him with a new travel companion and a new culinary adventure.

previousepisode.name: Miami to Key West with Eric Andre

nextepisode.name: Sonoma to the Pacific with Chris Ying

name: After the Bloom
summary: Adapted from Yi Shu's novel of the same name. A young woman's glamorous life shatters when she is suddenly imprisoned, only to discover that the romance she trusted was built on lies and schemes. Betrayal turns love into hatred, igniting her desire for revenge. When the bitter bloom finally fades, will she be left with ruin or a chance to begin again?

name: Back to Life
summary: Yu Jiuqi, an adopted daughter, falls in love with Sun Xi, the son of her family's sworn enemy. Bound by a decades-old blood feud, guilt forces them apart. Three years later, Sun Xi returns, reigniting both their buried love and lingering hatred. Beneath the freezing northeastern winter, they pretend to be strangers while secretly drawn to each other. Can love finally break the cycle of vengeance?

name: Last One Laughing: Halloween
summary: Over the course of the first Halloween special, the famous faces will use every ounce of their comedic talent to break their opponents without laughing or screaming. And it's not just their rivals they need to watch out for. Cursed props, ghostly interruptions and spine-tingling surprises are all designed to catch even the bravest comic off guard. The rules are simple: laugh and you're out, scream and you're out. Who will survive Last One Laughing: Halloween?

name: Почти настоящий детектив
summary: The star of the capital accidentally finds himself drawn into a high‑profile crime in a provincial town. The actor has to join forces with a police major who takes on the case while nine months pregnant, not only to save her reputation but also to unravel a whole tangle of lies.

name: Возвращение Титаника
summary: Bar owner Bob uses his sister, violinist Christina, who is addicted to drugs, to transport "white poison". Taking advantage of the sympathy of the artist, a special agent of the organized crime department, police major Georgiy Ivanovich, nicknamed Titanic, is introduced into the gang of drug dealers. He gets a job as Christina's bodyguard. A penchant for improvisation unexpectedly leads him to a situation where he has to choose between duty and conscience.

name: Возвращение Титаника-2
summary: The hero of the multi-part television series remains the good-natured and unremarkable-looking Titanic, a UBO agent. But appearances can often be deceiving, and Titanic is a clear example of this. He is fearless, intelligent, and cunning. He is a skilled psychologist. He has an unusually developed intuition. In his work as an undercover agent, he constantly takes risks, improvises, and at times seems more like an adventurer, which, incidentally, creates great difficulties for his superiors and colleagues. He received his unusual nickname precisely for these qualities, which often lead Titanic into hopeless and dangerous situations in which he "sinks." But, unlike the infamous ocean vessel, our Titanic invariably emerges victorious from all conflicts. Now he has been assigned to establish contact with a major leader of a regional criminal group nicknamed Nikei, who is running for governor of Russia's richest region. The crime boss's chances of winning are increasing with each passing day. Titanic's mission is to arrange for Nikey to be arrested red-handed for some specific illegal act, preventing him from running for office and simultaneously decapitating the organized crime group. The agent devises a highly ingenious method of infiltrating Nikey's inner circle, quickly winning his favor, and becoming the bandit's confidant...

name: Настоящий итальянец
summary: Russians and Italians need to get to know each other anew. Immerse themselves in the true Italian reality, and see the face of a true Italian. After all, behind the stereotypes and cliches that every traveler knows, lies a country that is immeasurably more profound and interesting.

name: Реальные кабаны
summary: The protagonist of the 16-episode comedy drama is Maxim, a race car driver. Amateur motor racing is an integral part of his life. Maxim owns a car repair shop. He manages a team of true professionals – three of his friends and his son, Boris. Just when the business is up and running, Maxim's wife, Lisa, files for divorce. Not only is her husband obsessed with cars, but he's also taken a mistress, a famous radio host!

name: Alif Laila
summary: Shahrzad narrates stories from the Arabian Nights, a collection of folk tales that brims with great morals, fascinating characters, flying carpets, magic lamps and fairies.

name: Unvoiced
summary: The series centers on prosecutor Fang Wei and follows a team of prosecutors as they pursue truth and justice through a series of complex cases. The main story revolves around Wei Feng, who is suspected of sexually assaulting and murdering Li Ran. Fang Wei joins forces with Xu Yishan, Chang Kaixin, and Zhou Yan to investigate the case. Despite numerous obstacles—including the suspect retracting his confession, pressure from the families involved, and intense public scrutiny—the team carefully pieces together the evidence and ultimately uncovers the conspiracy behind the crime. Alongside the central case, the series features several other investigations, including Zhou Yumei's murder of her husband, the Zhao Nanfeng murder case, the case involving Luan Pingping, and Cui Xiangqin's attempt to frame others through her suicide. As Fang Wei works to uncover the truth, he also faces personal and professional challenges that push him to grow. Together with his team, he remains committed to the principles of law and the pursuit of justice. Through these interconnected cases, the series portrays a group of dedicated prosecutors who stand firm under pressure and remain determined to uphold fairness and justice.

name: Bai Yao Pu
summary: To retrieve the *Manual of a Hundred Demons*, a motley crew ventures into the human world; through the interconnected tales of various demons, they reflect the realities of human life and the complexities of the human heart.

name: Hello SA
summary: Hayley Pearson, Lauren DeCesare and Tom Rehn bring a fresh new look to Sunday. Get all the tips for a short holiday or day out and start the week right with Hello SA.

name: Serial
summary: In Ashbourne Falls, Harold hides in plain sight, a quiet man with a dark compulsion to kill. Mabel, a disgraced nurse, moves through life with a dark secret. This is the story of two killers destined to collide.

name: Alif Laila
summary: The King of Baghdad, Shaharyar after being deceived by his wife had decided to marry a girl every day and kill her the very next day. He was angry and he wanted to kill every female alive. His minister's daughter, Shaharzad decided to marry him first in order to save other female's and to trick him with a bunch of stories. She convinced him to listen to her stories which were of Alif-Laila.

name: Settling
summary: Two disillusioned 30-somethings carry out their teenage pact - a platonic marriage - to satisfy family and societal expectations.

name: What a Boss Wants
summary: Kwon Do Hyeok, the emotionless CEO of SY Entertainment, has everything except peace of mind. Haunted by long-standing PTSD and crippling insomnia, he seeks help from a psychiatrist, who gives him an unusual prescription: find a woman whose voice can calm his nerves before his condition worsens. When an indie band's album lands on his desk, Do Hyeok hears a voice that instantly feels familiar—the same voice that once comforted him in his darkest moments. Determined to find the mysterious singer, he soon discovers that his father has also set his sights on her. As Do Hyeok races to find her first, his empty, emotionless life spirals into an unexpected romance, awakening feelings, and obsessive tastes he never knew he had.

name: The Ordinary Jackpot
summary: Things rarely change, but everything began to change. Eun-tae, who has been working as an ordinary employee, is burnt out from everything that happens to him. Everything from work to relationships with others, his life is filled with boredom. Suddenly, he becomes a lottery winner and gets 1.3 billion won. While it is a huge amount, realistically, it is hard for him to even purchase his own house in Seoul. After reviewing everything, he decides to live his life as he used to, but with a somewhat different mindset, as he has "insurance" that he can depend on.

name: A Father's Debt
summary: A retired chef's plans for a peaceful life are disrupted when his youngest son is defrauded of a large sum of money. Though not legally responsible for the debt, he sells his home and returns to work to help his son repay it.

name: Barbie Doll Adventures
summary: Welcome to Doll World! A beautiful place where all dolls live and play in harmony with a shared goal of inspiring future generations of girls to dream big and be anything!

name: Beach Sisters
summary:
Beach Sisters follows beach volleyball sisters Anouk and Zoé Vergé-Dépré through their first season as teammates on the road to the 2028 Olympic Games, offering exclusive insights into their lives as they balance elite sport, family, and personal challenges. 

After years of competing against each other, Anouk and Zoé are now united on the sand as one team. The documentary captures their journey as they strive to establish themselves among the world's best, highlighting not only their triumphs and setbacks on the court, but also the unique bond they share as sisters, and the physical and mental demands of life as elite athletes competing around the globe.

name: Hot Wheels: Monster Trucks Camp Crush
summary: Welcome to CAMP CRUSH! The most epic summer camp ever! Your favorite Monster Trucks will face off in a crash course to be the best and earn DESTRUCTION BADGES! The Trucks with the most badges by the end of Camp Crush will qualify to compete in the Champion's Cup! So pack your bags and get ready for #CAMPCRUSH!

name: We Are Family
summary: A chaotic three-person family unexpectedly finds themselves navigating high school together in the exact same classroom. The fast-paced series combines laugh-out-loud comedy with heartwarming dynamic shifts as parents and child attempt to survive everyday school life, strict teachers, and peer pressure under one shared roof—and one shared desk setup.

name: Forged in Foxborough
summary: Get an exclusive look at the New England Patriots with never-before-seen access inside the walls of Gillette Stadium.

name: Peacock NBA Monday
summary: Peacock NBA Monday is an exclusive weekly streaming broadcast block on Peacock featuring up to three live regular-season NBA games every Monday night, preceded by a dedicated 30-minute pre-game studio show.

nextepisode.name: Golden State Warriors at Denver Nuggets

name: Coast 2 Coast Tuesday
summary: Coast 2 Coast Tuesday is an NBA on NBC prime-time doubleheader format featuring an eastern/central regional game at 8:00 p.m. ET followed by a late-night western matchup starting at 11:00 p.m. ET (or 8:00 p.m. PT), bridging coast-to-coast basketball action across NBC and Peacock.

name: The Retrievals
summary: The Retrievals follows an unlikely community of IVF patients who come together to crusade against Yale University after they are operated on without anesthesia–because a nurse stole their fentanyl.

name: Good Rain Knows Its Season
summary: Good Rain Knows Its Season follows an aloof architect and a resilient single mother who both survived personal betrayals, finding quiet healing together in Dali.

name: Let's Get A Divorce, Miss Ye Can't Bear It Anymore
summary: Bound by a system to play a cold CEO's dutiful wife after a fatal accident, Ye Ningle endures five years of emotional neglect while he chases his first love. When her mission finally concludes, she demands her freedom—only for her indifferent husband to realize too late that he cannot let her go.

name: Honor Thy Mother
summary: A powerful CEO and a struggling actress from opposite worlds are forced into an unlikely partnership to rescue a company in crisis. As they fight to rebuild its reputation, old betrayals and lingering resentment resurface, putting both their fragile partnership and their chance at redemption to the ultimate test.

name: Buried with Michael Sheen
summary: What is the truth lying beneath our feet? Michael Sheen uncovers claims of conspiracy, complicity and denial over alleged toxic 'forever chemical' contamination in South Wales.

name: Et monsters bekendelser
summary: After being contacted by arms dealer Peter Frederiksen, a pair of journalists find themselves unraveling a harrowing global crime spree.

name: My Years as the Dragon-Seeking Master
summary: Zhang Tianyou, heir to the ancient dragon-seeker lineage, enters the world of tomb raiding as a live-in son-in-law, maneuvering among the four great families. His journey leads him back to the Tide Tomb, a place of mystery from twenty years ago. Through deadly mechanisms, thread puppets, hallucinogenic poisons, restless spirits, and a woman's coffin, he pieces together the truth that will change everything.

name: Advantage Player
summary: When a brilliant misfit discovers the secret to beating casinos at their own game, she's pulled into a world of obsessive outlaws who all live by one rule: the only way to beat the system is to outplay the people who built it.

name: Brutalt brorskap: Oslo
summary: A rare insight into the environments that shaped Norway: the wars between the men who ruled the streets, the headlines that dominated the media, and the lives that were lost.

name: Minimum Wage
summary: An overwhelmed group of teenagers struggles to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss, and minimum wage salaries. The stakes are low, and the pressure is immense.

name: Sunshine Girls
summary: Valley Hills is a perfectly nice California suburb… unless you're like Olivia,  who has lived in New York City her whole life. When her parents split up, Olivia is suddenly the new kid at Valley High, where she meets horse girl Taylor and influencer Riley. Freshman year comes at them fast, with false starts, first kisses, and family drama — but together these unlikely best friends will find their place in the sun.

name: Sid & Zoey
summary: Sid is a seductive, sophisticated, and amoral teenager from New York, sent to live with a police chief and his family in the idyllic Mississippi town where his mother grew up. Among them is the chief's sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter, Zoey. Resisting their mutual attraction, Sid and Zoey find themselves drawn into a dark, hidden world beneath the town's picture-postcard facade — and a paranormal puzzle that may well get them killed (if they don't kill each other first). It's a fish-out-of-water tale focused on an unlikely pair with plenty of scares.

name: Kraken. El libro negro de las horas
summary: Kraken receives a mysterious call demanding he find a valuable book; if he fails, his mother will be killed. The catch? His mother has been dead for decades. Alongside his inseparable partner Esti, he must unravel a complex case filled with suspense, action, and emotion.

name: An Amputation Obsession: The Monster and the Surgeon
summary: Vascular surgeon Neil Hopper becomes a symbol of hope after losing both legs, until an investigation uncovers a hidden obsession and secret life.

name: Alan Partridge BBC Specials
summary: A series of specials across the BBC featuring Steve Coogan's character Alan Partridge.

previousepisode.name: Alan Partridge: Why, When, Where, How and Whom?

name: Alan Partridge Sky Specials
summary: A series of specials across Sky featuring Steve Coogan's character Alan Partridge.

name: Somebody Knows Something
summary: True crime influencer Kara Chamberlain investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have long stumped both professional and amateur sleuths.

name: Sexslaven
summary: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner

name: Oswald
summary: Oswald the Lucky Rabbit, one of Disney's earliest characters who predated Mickey Mouse, is back for the 21st century.

name: Oracles & Prophets
summary: Out of the mists of oracles emerge spectres of the future. Throughout history, mystics, soothsayers, haruspices, and harbingers of doom have dealt out dispatches from beyond the veil. What ineffable materials made their predictions possible?

previousepisode.name: Prophecies of Freedom, Blood Rain, Didyma

name: Race Against the Tide
summary: Sand and deliver! In beautiful St Andrews, Iain Stirling challenges sand sculptors to create magical masterpieces - before the waves crash in. But only one team can take the crown.

name: Ming Ming Jiu Shi He Jiu De Guan Xi
Vår verdensarv
summary: Norway has eight sites on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Join Silje Nordnes on a journey of discovery through Norway's World Heritage.

name: Taste of Love
summary: A young chef is successful in every aspect of his life owing to a secret: he possesses the extraordinary ability to read other people's minds. Another young man who has a chronic condition—a fear of being stared at by others, which causes him to make mistakes in everything he does. They both end up working at the same place, and a series of chaotic and humorous events unfolded when they sleep together, resulting in a special transfer of energy. From someone who was always confident to someone who was always afraid of people—how will they solve this problem?

name: Emergency 24/7
summary: In the race to save lives, every second counts. Witness up close how a team comes together to care for A&E's most critically ill patients.

name: The Killing of James Bulger
summary: The definitive background to the abduction and murder of toddler James Bulger, which shocked the nation in 1993, and continues to resonate to this day.

name: Take a Hike!
summary: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

name: A Beautiful Obsession
summary: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

name: S&X
summary: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

name: LION
summary: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

name: Pappas flicka
summary: Frank is not just a dad - he's also a high school teacher. But when his daughter Jonna gets her father as her teacher, she decides to drop out.

name: Apocalypse
summary:
If the world as we know it came to an end, what would you do? 

Our modern world exists on a knife edge, but if the worst happened, the fight for survival won't be in jungles, forests or desert islands. It'll be in the towns and cities we call home. 

In this bold and ambitious social experiment, Channel 4 is sending a group of ordinary people to a jaw dropping, real world location - an abandoned town that bears all the hallmarks of being ravaged by an apocalyptic event.  They'll have to survive for 28 days without running water, heating, or electricity. They'll need to scavenge for food and supplies, reusing and repurposing anything they find but only if they can muster skills and wherewithal to do it. 

Nothing here comes easy, and in the face of scarce resources will this unlikely group of strangers band together or fall apart?

name: Sam & Pete: Dying to Look Good
summary:
Meeting the men redefining what it means to be a modern man of today, Sam & Pete: Dying to Look Good will explore trends including looksmaxxing, and the lengths many go to to achieve physical perfection, t-maxxing (testosterone boosting) and biohacking, an insight into the anti ageing obsessives who are determined to turn back the clock.

From bonesmashing to bodybuilding, cryotherapy to cosmetics, Sam and Pete will immerse themselves in the surprising and at times shocking universe of male self improvement, giving audiences an access all areas insight into the men taking bold steps in their quest for perfection.

name: Lego Disney Princess
summary: A series of animated streaming television specials based on both the Lego Disney toyline and Disney Princess franchise.

name: Love You to Death
summary: Was Lisa Hayden-Johnson's son Matthew really Britain's sickest child? Doctors, police and family members tell their story behind the shocking deception.

name: Viza za budućnost
summary: The family of Bosniaks lives in apartment of Serb family Golijanin, because their apartment is destroyed in war. The drama begins when family Golijanin comes back from Norway to Sarajevo because of nostalgia. The family Husika doesn't want to leave the apartment until they get the new one and they don't want to let Golijanins in.

name: L'Arène
summary: Ciryl Gane, Cédric Doumbè and Benoît Saint Denis put 38 amateur fighters through brutal tests and cage bouts for a shot at €100,000 and a pro MMA contract.

previousepisode.name: Je peux le finir en 30 secondes

name: Spesialklassen
summary: Mads Hansen is the new principal, and is taking the Special Class to camp school.

name: Muddle Earth
summary: The series follows the adventures of Randalf the wizard and his human apprentice Newt as they attempt to thwart the devious attempts of Dr Cuddles, an evil blue teddy bear, from taking over the land.

name: Tarbuck's Luck
summary: Jimmy Tarbuck stars in his own variety show for the BBC comprising a mixture of stand-up comedy, sketches and musical performances.

name: Doom Castle
summary: Serial concerning the Jacobite attempts to aid the return of Bonnie Prince Charlie to Britain.

name: Unfiltered with Lucy Kennedy
summary: Known and loved by audiences for her warmth, humour and unique ability to connect with people from all walks of life, Lucy is stepping away from her usual sleepovers and welcoming guests into her own bespoke living room for a series of candid and entertaining conversations.

previousepisode.name: Een vermomde Fien Germijns gaat de culinaire toer op

name: Kristel
summary: How do you stay a mom when life throws challenges your way? Kristel Verbeke meets courageous women with stories that truly touch the heart.

name: Karmaphal Daata Shani
summary: The story of the series is based on the life of God Shani, who is known for his wrath. The serial also shows Vishnu and Shiva as Shani's mentors. It also shows Shani's tough childhood, getting the rank of Karmafaldaata, downfall, return to Suryalok, marriage, getting his wife's curse and finally his return as Karmfaldaata.

name: Пора на завод
summary: Young and successful Moscow investor Vadim changes his привычный life dramatically for the sake of his love for his girlfriend Tanya. To earn the respect of Tanya's father, Igor Romanovich, a stern foreman and metallurgist, Vadim, who has never even held a plane in his hands, gets a job at an Ural metallurgical plant. The heat of the workshops, the crude humor of his colleagues, and the unbearable physical demands are just a small part of the trials Vadim faces. Will he be able to endure a whole month without his usual comfort, find true friends, and win the respect of the tough metallurgists? And most importantly, what will Vadim have to change in himself in order to finally be accepted as "one of their own"?

name: All Access with Linsey Davis
summary: All Access with Linsey Davis, is where culture meets conversation. Hosted by "World News Tonight" Sunday and "Prime" anchor Linsey Davis, will feature dynamic discussions with the celebrities, politicians, athletes and cultural influencers everyone is talking about. Each episode dives into the personalities fueling today's news, offering fresh perspectives on the moments that matter.

name: Searched
summary: Searched offers daily news programming that decodes the day's curiosities, using a unique data-driven approach to uncover the questions and stories audiences want to know about now. Hosted by "Good Morning America" weekend co-anchor and transportation correspondent Gio Benitez and correspondent Ashan Singh, "Searched" pulls real-time data from the top search engines and social media platforms to provide topical news for the audience.

name: Burden of Proof
summary: "Burden of Proof" is daily programming that focuses on the most talked-about trials. A panel of ABC News legal experts and analysts will discuss the facts of the cases in the headlines.

name: Doctor's Note
summary: Doctor's Note will providing medical facts, context and analysis of health trends, habits and myth-busting claims to help viewers live a happier, healthier and safer life.

name: Faraway With You
summary: Living between Beijing and Tianjin, Fang Yuan falls from the highs of career and love into a difficult crossroads. With Meng Yu by his side, he rebuilds his life through entrepreneurship, but their budding romance is tested when his past comes back.

name: Eclipse in the Lost City
summary: During the war-torn era of the Republic of China, Ningcheng was plunged into turmoil. Lu Ye, the Young Chief of the Qingtian Gang, returned from studying abroad to discover that Police Chief Shen Tianbai had killed his father. Concealing his anger, Lu Ye spent a long time interacting with and testing the down-and-out, amnesiac Shen Tianbai, unaware that Shen was actually a lone hero working undercover within the ruthless Shisha Gang. Once sworn enemies, the two gradually developed an inseparable bond as they unraveled hidden clues amid gang conflicts and police corruption. In the end, they put a stop to a deadly wolf-poison experiment that threatened the lives of Ningcheng's residents, brought down the mastermind behind the criminal underworld, saved the people of Ningcheng, and upheld their faith and devotion to their country.

name: Live 'n Deadly
summary: Live and unpredictable Saturday morning show presented by action adventurer Steve Backshall and Naomi Wilkinson, crammed full of animals, adventure, challenges and dares.

name: Deadly Art
summary: Inspired by his amazing list of Deadly 60 animals, Steve Backshall challenges a team of artists to create some astounding deadly animal art.

name: Deadly 360
summary: Join Steve Backshall as he enters the high-tech Deadly 360 Mission Control to re-create and analyse in forensic detail three thrilling hunts, by some of the world's most fearsome predators.

name: La mujer prohibida
summary: When Victor Rodríguez saves Karen Arbeláez from being shot during an assassination attempt, their lives become inexplicably intertwined. But reality has a habit of getting in the way of fate: Victor is a famous musician searching for a meaningful connection, and Karen is married to an up-and-coming politician. That doesn't stop their love from growing — even as their obligations, fears, and loved ones' ambitions get in the way.

name: La mujer prohibida
summary: Irene Rivas, a 26-year-old mute woman, is forced to marry the ruthless Germán Gallardo in order to save her father from prison. However, Irene is in love with Carlos Luis, Germán's son. Irene tries to find happiness, but discovers many secrets from the past that could destroy her future forever.

name: Insula Iubirii
summary: Temptation Island Romania (locally known as Insula Iubirii) is a reality show that tests the fidelity of couples in an exotic location. The format separates romantic partners for several weeks, placing them into two luxury villas filled with attractive singles ("temptations") to see if their relationships can survive.

name: The Tyrant's Bride-To-Be
summary: One day, Ha Na wakes up to find herself in the world of a romance novel—as the first fiancée of the male lead. The problem? Her character is a minor one destined to be poisoned at the engagement party of Cheon Nam Ju, heir to the Cheonnam Group. To avoid her tragic fate, Ha Na proposes a contract marriage to Park U Jin, the notorious "tyrant" and acting chairman of the rival Samjeong Group. U Jin accepts the offer, and Ha Na's destiny begins to veer in an unpredictable direction.

name: Fool in Love
summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

name: Lieutenant Opas
summary: Lieutenant Opas didn't ask for his gift. But ever since he fell and hit his head during a practice mission, he has been able to see ghosts all around him. So even though his legs shake and he has to fight the urge to pee his pants, Lieutenant Opas keeps his new skill a secret and uses it to help him solve crimes. Working alongside the cool Bua Kwan, disbelieving Lieutenant Johnny and photographer Kam, can Lieutenant Opas overcome his fears to bring the spiritual criminals to justice?

name: TV, Biwi Aur Main
summary: An overworked daily-soap producer finds his life constantly derailed by the hilarious clash between his chaotic job and his domestic life. While he scrambles to manage arrogant lead actors, constant script blunders, and brutal production deadlines on set, his real trouble begins at home: his mother becomes obsessed with the virtuous heroine of his show, using this fictional character as a golden standard to constantly criticize his real wife—completely unaware that the television star is an insufferable diva off-camera while his actual wife is a sensible, grounded partner forced to deal with the absurd fallout.

name: Joseline's Cabaret: New York
summary: The Puerto Rican Princess makes her Cabaret return in the Big Apple, proving that she and her girls, can make it anywhere.

name: Гражданка Катерина
summary: After their mother's death, Katerina and her younger sister Sonya are offered help by their aunt, Svetlana. She takes Sonya from Moldova, where the girls grew up, to live with her in Moscow. It is assumed that Katerina will soon move to Russia as well and take her sister with her. However, Svetlana secretly takes guardianship of Sonya and announces that the girl will now live with her permanently. Katya urgently comes to Moscow to help her sister, who is finding it increasingly difficult to get along with the domineering Svetlana. To have any chance of challenging her aunt's guardianship, she enters into a фиктивный marriage with Stepan — this way, she obtains a residence permit and the prospect of obtaining Russian citizenship.

name: Русские в городе ангелов
summary: Semi-retired Moscow detective, Somov, is hired as a consultant on various LAPD investigations involving the Russian-Los Angeles community.

name: Янтарная комната
summary: For more than 70 years, the mystery of the disappearance of the famous Amber Room has remained unsolved. What we can see today is a brilliantly executed copy, while the original Amber Room was stolen by the Nazis from the Catherine Palace in the autumn of 1941. After the Victory, it disappeared without a trace.

name: Иосиф Бродский. Возвращение
summary: In January 1993, Joseph Brodsky appeared on Russian television for the first and last time. This happened in the city he loved so much: "If reincarnation exists, I would like to live my next life in Venice – to be a cat there, or anything else, but definitely in Venice." It was in this city that the poet was buried, on the Island of the Dead, in the San Michele cemetery, next to Stravinsky and Diaghilev, who, like him, were exiles who brought glory to Russia throughout the world. The cycle does not contain any voice‑over text. This is Brodsky's monologue, his reflections in the first person, a kind of philosophical essay "about the world, the beloved homeland, and about himself." With each passing year, with each passing day, his thoughts and words acquire an ever deeper and more piercing meaning, as if time is trying to catch up with the poet. Authors: Alexey Shishov, Elena Yakovich.

name: Jakarta Undercover: Members Only
summary: Sita is a journalist who decides to infiltrate a high-end prostitution club to investigate the mystery of her sister Tania's death. Her investigation leads her to meet Arian, a man who runs an exclusive business with a network of elite clients. The deeper Sita digs, the more secrets she uncovers. What began as a mere object of investigation turns into a dangerous game involving powerful people, money, and conflicting interests. To achieve her goals, Sita begins to manipulate Arian's feelings. However, as their relationship becomes more complicated, the lines between disguise and reality begin to blur. Amidst this game of intrigue, major questions arise: who is truly in control of the situation, and who is trapped within it.

name: Әпке
summary: A story about two sisters who lost their parents six years ago and, due to their age and circumstances, were unable to maintain a warm atmosphere and mutual understanding in their home. But after going through a series of harsh trials, it is the sense of family and home that will awaken their sisterly love and mutual affection. This is a story about the importance of family in anyone's life, about the wisdom of the older generation and the trust of the younger ones, about the moral purity of girls and the power of love, and about faith in the changes that await the characters.

name: Fatal Proximity to Him
summary: After a car accident, prima ballerina Luo Xiyu is transported back to 2014, where she meets He Lan, a notorious troublemaker. She soon discovers that their lives are mysteriously bound together: every time they fall in love, she dies all over again. Worse still, the two have been trapped in the same cycle, repeatedly meeting and falling for each other across different timelines. Determined to break the loop once and for all, Luo Xiyu and He Lan set out to uncover the killer and put an end to the deadly cycle.

name: Makkali The Love Tree
summary: Tankul, an astronomy teacher, discovers a naked, unconscious girl and assumes she's been assaulted. When she wakes, he finds she behaves like a child and has no injuries or bones. He realizes she is a makkali, a being from a different time. As their relationship grows romantic, Tankul wonders how a love between a human and a makkali can work.

name: Otra en Mí
summary: The story of the twins Liliana and Valentina that get separated at birth and end up rivaling for the love of the same man.

name: Legends
summary: When the cast of Sons of Anarchy reunites at a fan convention after more than a decade, the line between life and art blurs as the fractured brotherhood finds itself up against a real-world threat more dangerous than anything they ever faced in their show.

name: Хороший парень
summary: The main character of the series is the geologist Yasha Teplyakov. After many years of a nomadic life, he returns to Kulakovo to start over: to build a house, find a job, and finally find personal happiness. His first love, Svetlana, lives there. Rumour has it that she is not married and is raising her son alone, so Yasha hopes that fate will give them another chance. His childhood friends welcome Yasha like family. Despite their different personalities, they are always ready to support their friend and sincerely believe: "You're a good guy, everything will work out for you." Yasha's world is built on simple but firm principles: the strong should not harm the weak, lying is unacceptable, and those who find themselves in trouble must be helped. His garage, converted into an auto repair shop, becomes a place where people go when they have no one else to turn to. Over time, Yasha becomes an unofficial helper to the local police. For the head of the Kulakovsky police department, Lieutenant Colonel Shepelev, an old friend of Yasha's late father, such a person is both a boon and a source of…

name: Zhou Duan Ye Chang
summary:
On the first day of their divorce cooling-off period, Lu Zhengdong, Lin Banxia's estranged husband, suddenly experiences a bizarre glitch —his body begins uncontrollably switching between his adult and teenage forms. Forced into this absurd situation, Lin Banxia finds herself drawn into an unexpected chapter of their troubled relationship.

As the strange phenomenon continues, the two gradually let down the emotional defenses they have built around themselves. Beneath their strained marriage and unresolved conflicts lie two wounded hearts, each carrying pain they have never truly confronted.

Through this unexpected journey, Lu Zhengdong and Lin Banxia slowly rediscover the sincerity and affection that once brought them together. As they learn to face their past wounds and understand each other, they begin to heal and redeem one another through genuine love.

When the divorce cooling-off period finally ends, they are given one last chance to choose their future. Having shed their pretenses and rediscovered the love they once lost, Lu Zhengdong and Lin Banxia choose not to part ways, but to renew their marriage vows and begin their relationship anew.

name: The Food Affectionist
summary: Join Chef Lillie Giang as she travels around the country discovering amazing destinations, incredible local produce, unforgettable flavours, and cooking up delicious meals along the way.

name: Indefendable: Sans Trace
summary: The firm is reeling when a horrific murder case hits the headlines. The paths of two former clients have crossed: they didn't know each other, yet one of them had been waiting for this moment for a long time. The entire defense team is confronted with a disturbing reality: what if a client acquitted of an earlier offense turned out to be far more dangerous than they had imagined?

previousepisode.name: Y a-t-il un menteur dans la salle ?

name: Playback: Una somos dos
summary: Best friends Emma and Camila dream of becoming musicians despite family burdens—Emma can't sing after her father's death, and Camila's family forbids her from singing due to a hidden secret. When they fake a performance for a talent show, their success sparks fame, rivalry, and the risk of exposing Camila's secret and their friendship.

previousepisode.name: La gran gala final de Gluzz

name: Die Inseln der Queen
summary:
The pink sand beaches of Bermuda, the chalk cliffs of Southern England, the rolling hills of the South-East, the granite cliffs, snowy mountains, high and lowlands of the Scottish isles: the world's islands have an incredibly diverse array of stunning landscapes and fascinating cultures thriving in them.

Each episode of this sublime series features a different island country around the world, showcasing their natural beauty and their unique peoples and traditions. Parts of the story are told from a birds eye perspective, which presents the landscapes from a new and unique vantage point: We fly over spiky rock needles, discover secluded bays and gigantic bird colonies, buffeted by the sea. Every now and then the camera ‘discovers' a protagonist below, introducing us to a local who invites us into their way of life.

Whether its time for tea in the watch house of St. Mary, Bermuda Day parade in Hamilton, or time for treasure hunting on St. Kilda, this is your chance to explore the world's tiniest and most remote communities.

name: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! / Ave Mujica
summary: New anime with combined title that continues the story of BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! and BanG Dream! Ave Mujica.

name: Highland Clans
summary: Series in which Paul Murton uncovers the history of Scotland's most famous clans.

name: Вы заказывали убийство
summary: Based on novels by Stanislav Gurin, this crime drama follows Ignat Gromov, a former internal security officer whose wife, an investigative journalist named Lyuba, is targeted by a hitman after witnessing a banker's assassination. Despite Ignat's attempts to protect her, Lyuba is ultimately killed, driving him back into service to avenge her death and dismantle a ruthless human organ trafficking syndicate using his intelligence skills, all while discovering a unexpected second chance at love along the way.

name: Бухта страха
summary: When a husband redirects a couple's secluded coastal getaway to an isolated seaside resort, their tranquil vacation quickly spirals into a nightmare with the discovery of a murdered local woman. Isolated by geography and trapped in a close-knit community where secrets run deep, a perceptive visitor relies on her analytical instincts to unmask the perpetrator before becoming the next target.

name: Habeas Corpus
summary: A renowned law professor leads a team of students to prove a convicted man's innocence, only to discover her brightest pupil is bound to her past.

name: Scotland's Clans
summary: Paul Murton reveals the history of the families who lived on the border with England.

name: Resolve to Solve with Miles O'Brien
summary: Journalist Miles O'Brien meets the scientists, innovators and problem solvers tackling some of the world's most urgent challenges. He travels the globe to learn how science and ingenuity are dealing with issues such as extreme heat, methane emissions from cattle, brain disorders and shrinking water supplies.

name: Lao Po Fen Liao Jie Yi Xia
9/11: Reunited
summary:
9/11 Reunited tells the story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again. 

Made with the 9/11 Memorial & Museum to mark the 25th anniversary, this major new series foregrounds stories of heroism and humanity amidst the worst terror attacks in U.S. history.

name: Love After Lockup: Relationship Rehab
summary: Five fan-favorite couples from the hit Love After Lockup franchise will join psychiatrist and nationally recognized relationship expert, Dr. Ish Major, to repair their broken bonds.

name: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
summary: Step inside Khloé Kardashian's inner circle as her closest friends navigate the highs and lows of motherhood, marriage, dating, business, and life in the spotlight. From career milestones and family challenges to girls' trips, launch parties, and life-changing decisions, these ambitious women come together through their shared connection to Khloé. But as they spend more time together and get to know one another on a deeper level, unexpected tensions, old wounds, and clashing perspectives begin to surface - testing whether these friendships can grow as their lives continue to evolve.

name: Панда и Крош
summary: Panda and Krash follows the adventures of an impulsive little Rabbit and a loyal Panda.

name: One-Room TA
summary: When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?

name: Perfect Addiction
summary: Akihito is a college student obsessed with good looks and carnal pleasure, but he can't stand the handsome-yet-aloof Sae. Things come to a head when Akihito is shot down at a singles mixer by a girl who's set her romantic sights on Sae. Furious, he follows Sae to the hotel district where he learns Sae's secret: he's gay, and he's having trouble enjoying himself in the bedroom. Breaking through Sae's mental barriers is exactly the sexy challenge Akihito needed. It awakens something in them both. Will they ever be able to control themselves again?

name: Seeing Double
summary:
Seo-woo reunites with Ra-on, the crush from his school days. Because of his shy nature, he asks his twin brother, Jae-woo, to step in and flirt on his behalf.

However, Jae-woo—who initially had no interest—finds himself falling for Ra-on before he knows it...

A sizzling love triangle born from a sweet, unrequited crush.

Who will ultimately win Ra-on's heart?

name: Please Save My Earth
summary: Please Save My Earth follows Arisu Sakaguchi, a high school student who begins experiencing vivid dreams of a past life on a lunar base — and discovers her classmates share the same memories. As Arisu is drawn deeper into the mystery of her former existence, a young boy next door awakens to a past-life persona consumed by love for Mokuren. The intense passions and sins of their previous lives collide with the present, gradually revealing a shocking truth — and an unexpected connection between Arisu and Mokuren that binds their fates across lifetimes.

name: Fine Point With Chanel Rion
summary: Chanel Rion hosts honest discussions on Big Tech, Big Media and Big Government issues. Watch on OAN.

name: แดง ไบเล่ย์
summary: Forced onto the path of crime by circumstances beyond his control, a man must confront the consequences of his choices while discovering the true meaning of friendship, dignity, love, and family.

name: Andrew Bennett
summary: A mysterious hunter of cursed books uses a magical doorway that travels across realms to arrive in a town plagued by a series of gruesome, unexplained murders. Teaming up with a skeptical local police inspector, he uses his knowledge of the occult to track down dark grimoires and uncover a sinister ritual that threatens to unleash an apocalyptic force.

name: Учёные дамы
summary: The documentary-animated series "Scientist Ladies" is dedicated to eight disciplines: mathematics, chemistry, biology, physics, meteorology, geology, microbiology, and astronomy. Each episode tells the story of outstanding women scientists of the 19th and 20th centuries who achieved academic success despite limited access to education, stereotypes, and public opinion. How did their achievements influence the development of various fields of knowledge, and which contemporary women scientists are advanced science today? The voice of the project is actress Irina Gorbacheva.

name: Bannerman
summary: Paul Bannerman, a lethal covert operative, convinces a group of the world's most deadly assassins to quit the spy game for a chance to lead normal lives in the suburbs of Connecticut. Old enemies, bad habits, a paranoid government and an unrelenting ex-cop will make retirement their most difficult mission yet.

name: Real America With Dan Ball
summary: Dan Ball brings political headlines by interviewing newsmakers of the day.

name: The Headlands House
summary: In The Headlands House, a marriage begins to fracture after a gay couple moves into their dream home, only to discover that its prior residents were brutally murdered on the property—and that their own lives may now be in danger, too.

name: Charterfeber Danmark
summary: Famous Danes and new personalities travel to Gran Canaria to have a blast. Love, partying, chaos and conflicts hit from the start when Susanne and Kjeld and Simone and Bettina embark on a vacation where nothing goes as planned.

name: Floribella
summary:
If Cinderella were a 21st-century girl, how would she act? Instead of scrubbing floors, doing mountains of laundry, and waiting for Prince Charming, she would certainly be fighting for a job and for the person she loves, right?

That is exactly who Flor, the protagonist of Floribella, is. Like any 19-year-old woman, she has dreams that aren't always easy to achieve. Even so, she is the embodiment of high spirits. Cheerful and intelligent—yet clumsy at times—she doesn't let obstacles get her down; instead, she faces life's challenges with plenty of music, dance, and adaptability.

name: Sans retour
summary: Convicted as a teenager for a double murder she may not have committed, Emma is released on a suspended sentence after fifteen years behind bars. Returning to Kerlan—the island where the tragedy unfolded—she confronts her past within a community that rejects her, starting with her own son…

name: Karmic Loop
summary: In the modern world where no demons exist, Lin Yan, a man of mystic arts, finds his powers useless until he accidentally enters the otherworldly Zijin Lou. As a dungeon bug, he meets Zhang Mingming and hacker Ma Xiaoguai, but soon the boss Tian Buying unleashes monsters of the Seven Deadly Sins to hunt them down. The three brave the bizarre dungeon, with Lin Yan using his abilities to slip through the cracks of its rules, clearing level after level and uncovering the conspiracy and everyone's secrets.

name: Floribella
summary: Floribella is a modern-day Cinderella. This story also features witches and a Prince... and a dream to be realised.

name: Floribella
summary: An unexpected inheritance changes the life of a young woman who is about to live out all her dreams.

name: Danny Go!
summary: "Danny Go!" is a live-action educational children's show filled with music, learning and silliness. Created in 2019 by 3 childhood friends in Charlotte, North Carolina, the purpose of the show is to inspire creativity, confidence and kindness in kids from ages 2-7.

name: Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories
summary: Join Thomas, Percy, Rosie and all their friends as they work together and form lasting bonds that help them overcome any obstacle.

name: Fired Up!
summary: Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life's challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

name: La Cible
summary: Hugo, a professional bodyguard, is going through a painful divorce. Still in love with his ex-wife, he tries to maintain a bond with his children. But everything changes the day he attends his son's birthday party: his ex-wife and their two children are kidnapped right before his eyes.

name: El César
summary: El César tells the story of a country that watched an idol fall and a man rise again. This dramatized biographical series traces the life of Julio César Chávez, the legendary Mexican boxer and global icon of the sport.

name: American Candidate
summary: American Candidate is a 2004 political reality competition TV series hosted by Montel Williams.

name: Biester
summary: Two worlds collide when two best friends from modest backgrounds dreaming of a better life cross paths with two wealthy sisters. Amid love, lies, and recklessness, cracks form in the glamorous world of the privileged.

name: The Bedmate Game: Sharehouse
summary: Ju Yeon subs in on a R-rated dating reality show. Intimate contact is mandatory and bed mate swaps every night! Ex-boyfriend In Ho, nice Jae Hui, and sexy Se Heon is waiting for her in the share house. And their exes start moving in... Participants approach her through a moral-bending rule. Romance vs Money, Instinct vs Reason. Ju Yeon's shaky decision-making begins.

name: The One Who Loves You
summary: After divorcing a husband who betrayed her during their seven-year marriage—and subsequently becoming a laughingstock within her family—the protagonist unexpectedly begins a relationship with a younger male college student. While he appears innocent, he harbors a deep, seven-year-long obsession with her and possesses a powerful background; amidst a tug-of-war involving a contractual arrangement and calculated maneuvers, the two find mutual redemption and stage a powerful comeback.

name: Haysiyet
summary: "Dignity" will bring to the screen the conflict between two diametrically opposed families and an impossible love that blossoms amidst this conflict. Mehmet, played by Doğukan Güngör, will appear before the audience as a young man from the neighborhood with goals and ideals, but who never compromises on his principles no matter what. The character's biggest test will be the difficult choice he will have to make between his love and his honor.

name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
summary: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

name: The Murder Detective
summary: A gripping real-world thriller, seven years in the making, telling the inside story of the complex, high-risk police investigation into the murder of journalist Lyra McKee

name: Sua Mãe Te Conhece
summary: In this new reality show format, nine mothers secretly bet on the choices their adult children will make, putting their familial bonds to the test.

name: Chumbak
summary: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

name: Evening Star For You
summary: High school teacher Song Wan Xing's ex-boyfriend cheated on her, didn't give a dowry, and wanted a Mercedes-Benz as a dowry. Her family was not good either: her stepfather was a pervert and her mother was weak. She got married to the neurosurgeon Jin Ze after a blind date. It is a healing love story of marriage first, love later, and long-lasting love and companionship.

name: Anti-Terrorism Special Forces: The Wolves
summary: Childhood friends Qin Xiaoyang and Tang Shi take diverging paths after a life-changing incident—one becomes an elite undercover agent, the other a vigilante for hire. When Qin infiltrates a deadly terrorist group, the two are forced into a tense confrontation, where past bonds clash with present loyalties in a battle between justice and revenge.

name: The Producer
summary: When an aspiring music producer teams up with a veteran mogul, the unlikely duo sets out to conquer the Mandopop scene.

name: The Matt Gaetz Show
summary: Former congressman Matt Gaetz brings his Washington insider perspective to headlines.

name: Проект Подиум
summary: The battle of 15 young designers for a ticket into the world of high fashion — now in Russia! MTV held a huge casting and selected the most outstanding and talented participants. For each of them, the PODIUM Project is the main chance in life to become a famous professional fashion designer.

name: No Crushing Allowed
summary: No Crushing Allowed follows nineteen-year-olds forbidden to date who find themselves falling in love for the first time, set against the backdrop of two prestigious rival schools — Jinwol Boys' High and Jinwol Girls' High — separated by a single wall. Urban legend has it that whoever hops the wall will pay the price, while the schools' strict policy is clear: get caught dating, and you're expelled. Heartfluttering moments and the thrill of first love unfold alongside the highs and lows of modern-day school life, promising to leave viewers feeling nostalgic and swooning.

name: Lalka
summary: This stylish new take on the classic Polish novel chronicles the many attempts of an ambitious merchant to win the heart of a nobleman's daughter.

name: Sevdan Bir Ateş
summary: Mirza and Leyla's wedding is cut short when Leyla disappears just a few hours before the ceremony. For the next seven years, no one hears a word from Leyla. Just as Mirza decides to rebuild his life and is about to marry Destan, his seven-month-old nephew Kerem is kidnapped by his own father, a human trafficker. Mirza travels to Aleppo to find his nephew and the brother-in-law who abducted him. However, Aleppo will return to Mirza not only Kerem but also Leyla, who has left him in agony for seven years. As Mirza fights a grueling battle to rescue Leyla and 6-year-old Hüma—whom he does not know is his own daughter—from Syria, a fierce struggle against his own family awaits him in Cappadocia.

name: Les évaporés
summary: A police commander and two civilian volunteers form a unique and somewhat unconventional team. Their mission: to search for "voluntary disappearances" on behalf of their families and loved ones—disappearances that the police, lacking sufficient evidence, cannot investigate.

name: To Catch A Smuggler: Contraband Capture
summary: CBP and HSI respond to a surge in cocaine trafficking across U.S. land borders and at sea, which leads to boat chases, arrests and record-setting seizures...

name: Taskmaster NL
summary: Five comedians throw themselves into the most diverse, absurd, and surprising challenges. Under high time pressure, with limited resources, and above all, complete freedom. Anything goes, nothing makes sense. Ultimately, taskmaster Arjen Lubach decides who gets points, assisted by his dedicated assistant Diederik Smit.

name: Khom Khlang
summary: Bulan, a woman with a mysterious aura, crosses paths with Peem, a police officer desperate to solve a case for which the law offers no answers. Recommended as the only one capable of helping her, Bulan awakens in Peem doubts, attraction, and an unexpected bond that will challenge her beliefs and her understanding of justice.

name: Love's Tempest
summary: 1921... Jao Karmfah is a nobleman from Chiang Mai. As an arrangement by family members, he is engaged to Yaowalak. After returning to Chiang Mai for business, he falls in love with Fongkae at first sight. Karmfah decides to break off his engagement with Yaowalak to pursue Fongkae. However, Fongkae already has a man she loves, Khun Chai Yingsak Warangkorn. Fongkae's parents prefer Karmfah as their son-in-law and locks Fongkae away, pending her nuptials to Karmfah. Yingsak sneaks into Fongkae's home and takes her away. Upon hearing of this, Karmfah quickly chases them. When he finds them, he realizes that he cannot force anyone to love him. Just as Yaowalak could not force him to love her. He allows them to be together, and gives Fongkae a hair brooch he had specially crafted for her. Fongkae and Yingsak would go on to have two children, Mom Luang Sakchai and Mom Luang Sommapa. Yaowalak, who was labelled as a disgrace by society when her fiance abandoned her, meets Than Chai Kietkong Suppakhun. He quickly becomes smitten by Yaowalak. But he has a secret relationship with one of the royal servants in his palace, Pleum. Pleum would fall pregnant with Kietkong shortly before he is to wed Yaowalak. Pleum keeps the pregnancy a secret and marries the royal chauffeur, Fu. Pleum would give birth to Plaewadee. Kietkong marries Yaowalak and has a daughter, Mom Ratchawongse (Khun Ying) Yorkiet, nicknamed Yingyor. The lives of their children would later become intertwined with the brothers Pakinai and Pubadee. Both are children of Yaowalak and Kietkong's close friends. The decisions of their parents will bring upon a complicated and tangled web of deceit, love, and lies. However, the story does not end with the children, as the parents will also have to answer for their own desires and loves.

name: Bank of Hollywood
summary: Wealthy patrons ("moguls") listened to pitches from people asking for money to solve personal or professional problems, deciding whether to fund them.

name: Moonbird
summary: On a remote island off the coast of Lutruwita (Tasmania), a 13-year-old Palawa boy navigates the complexities of his world alongside his father, a man shaped by his past and the challenges of raising his son.

name: Plannosaurus: Serious Paleontology Club
summary: Kanna, a second-year middle school student aspiring to be an idol, goes to the paleontology club to complain about noise. There, she is forcibly challenged to a quiz competition by Tetori, a paleontology enthusiast, with her club membership as the stake! Did Tyrannosaurus Rex stand upright like that monster? Or did it have feathers? What are the secrets of dinosaurs whose appearance changed over time?!

name: Cat Tales
summary:
"What if cats appeared in those stories...?"
When cats are added to famous folktales and fairy tales, a heartwarming and surreal new development unfolds...!?
Tabby, orange tabby, calico, white cat, and many other kinds of cats x folktales - guaranteed to soothe all of humanity!
An adorable cat comedy begins!

name: Babies of Bread
summary:
In a bakery late at night, when everyone is asleep, bread dough, affectionately known as "baby bread,"
rests quietly in the refrigerator . But secretly, they wake up and gather together to chat, clean , and even fight. Or, during the day, they bask in the sun on the roof. Because they are still "dough" before being baked, they can change and have endless possibilities. This is the everyday adventure of these ignorant, timid, and sometimes brave baby breads .

name: Mecard Ball
summary: Basketball, Baseball, Soccer... When it comes to handling a ball, Cha Youngwoong, a fifth-grade elementary school student, exhibits overwhelming abilities. One day, while cleaning out the warehouse at the request of his mother, he discovers a mysterious marble. At that moment, the villain duo "Team MABORI" and the monster creature 'Pachyla' appear to break the warehouse and threaten the hero, but With the help of the Mechanimal 'Akan' hidden in the warehouse, he uses a mysterious orb - 'Mecard Ball' to succeed in defeating them. After that, Cha Youngwoong hears a surprising story from Akan... Mechanimals living with ball energy that have existed on Earth for a long time. Cha Youngwoong's ability to handle a ball freely is said to be related to his mother. He is determined to find the lost memories of his mother and protect the peace of the earth. Mysterious characters appear one after another in front of Cha Youngwoong who begins to collect Mecard Balls and Mechanimals, and a battle unfolds. From the mysterious girl Sera to Kirayan who threatens the earth. Will he be able to regain his mother's memory and protect the peace of the earth with Akan?

name: Это Москва. Приятно познакомиться!
summary: "This is Moscow. Nice to meet you!" — a new travel show in which, together with Nadezhda Mikhalkova, Maxim Lutchak, and invited guests, we will examine the image of the capital "back then," "now," and "forever": we will take a walk through modern urban spaces, old Moscow addresses, and places familiar to everyone from movies.

name: Caesar
summary: Caesar is an enigmatic personality with unusual powers, after killing his extremist group he was put in prison until another group demand for him.

name: Knights of the Cross
summary: Knights of the Cross is an epic Christian mini-series set during the Third Crusade. King Richard the Lionheart battles illness, doubt, and Sultan Saladin in a decisive struggle for Jerusalem and the future of Christendom.

name: Rising Girl
summary: Wanjai is a young girl who has the talent to sing, but her mother was against her becoming a singer. One day, a close friend secretly records videos of Wanjai singing and uploads them on youtube - she became an internet idol overnight and received the nickname "Sao Noi Roy Lan View". Various music labels want to sign with her, including Anawin. He wants to prove himself to his father, who is the owner of a giant luk thung (country) music company.

name: I Pickled & Picked You
summary: During the coronavirus crisis, Namphon's factory was forced to close down. One of his former employees becomes a competitor, running a business from a fermented fish formula he had stolen from Namphon. Biding the time in hopes to take over Namphon's company, Namphon's son Kirin has to rush home from abroad to save his father's company, with the goal to make Pla-Ra Juicy Spice the top brand in Thailand!
